title: Implement Intersecting Lighthouse Light-Refraction Puzzle with In-Game HUD Guidance in PlayScene2
description: Upgrade the twin lighthouse stage (Misty Marsh) in PlayScene2 to feature a cooperative light beam refraction puzzle with carryable items (Ignition Crank and Ancient Prism), asymmetric Father/Child coordination, laser alignment to unlock the Giant Watermill, comprehensive in-game HUD tutorial banners, floating interaction prompts, and clean up legacy lily pad throw objects with baked PlayScene2 scene file.
acceptance_criteria: PlayScene2.unity scene file is saved and committed with new puzzle objects (IgnitionCrank, East_FallenLogPuzzle, AncientPrism, LuminaMillSensor_Lens); legacy lily pads and floating gem are removed/hidden.
Prominent top-screen HUD Objective Banner updates dynamically across 4 puzzle phases.
Proximity floating prompts display clear action text: [E] Nhặt, [E] Cắm vào bệ, [E] Nâng thân cây, [A/D] Xoay hướng tia sáng.
Child picks up Ignition Crank with [E] and inserts into West Tower to activate primary beam.
Father lifts fallen log with [E]; Child crawls through CoopCrawlVolume to retrieve Ancient Prism and sockets it on East Tower.
Adjusting steering wheels with [A/D] aligns primary beam to prism and refracted secondary beam to LuminaMillSensor.
Triggering sensor illuminates both beacons, clears marsh fog, and lifts watermill safety boom permanently.
test_command: Unity Editor MenuItem: 'Hold My Hand/Level 2/Wire Beacons Watermill and Victory'
risks: Ensure PlayScene2.unity scene file is explicitly marked dirty and saved to disk so Unity loads the new objects.
Ensure HUD banners and world-space prompts are localized in clear Vietnamese and visible regardless of distance.
